name: Enchant Strider is 35% stronger with a single two-handed weapon (#12337)
contract: #12337: Enchant Weapon - Strider (20044) reads 'often increase Agility by ${$20046m1+$20046ppl1} for $20046d
... This is 35% stronger if you are wielding a single two handed weapon.' Its proc buff Strider (20046) is
aura 29 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_STAT, misc 1 Agility), BasePoints 39 + 1 die, 2.0 points per level from BaseLevel 30
to MaxLevel 60, so a level 60 player gets 40 + 60 = 100 Agility. Nothing applied the 35%. With a one-handed
Worn Shortsword (25) the buff must stay at 100; with Arcanite Reaper (12784, a two-handed axe) in the main hand
and an empty off hand it must be 135. The buff is cast directly, so only its amount is under test, not the

steps.label: a one-handed sword in the main hand
CONTROL: a one-hander gives the base 100 Agility
DISCRIMINATING: a single two-hander makes Strider 35% stronger
